limits: Fixed metadata is an AppShell experiment, not production startup/API latency.
Images remain real remote HTTPS resources; network and dynamic refresh vary.
PSS and Graphics are end-of-scene snapshots, not peaks.
Flutter raster duration is not hardware GPU duration or FPS.
Early online baseline/images vs reliable/paint use changing source catalogs and cannot establish cross-batch memory causality.
Image probes run on the development host; response times include transfer but not on-device first-frame.
No video playback decoder or first-frame benchmark in this image scenario.
